description: The crossing fixture of factory graph 3 (b3-flow-radar), read by AT5 and AT13 of tests/factory-graph-3.test.mjs. It is deliberately not a market call: the payloads are the smallest ones that still validate against both contracts of every node, and what the fixture proves is that the six contracts fit into one another and that each gate's routing is an edge the graph declares — never that any reading of any ticker is right. The data it quotes is real and comes from the bundle's own day-1 fixture (B3, 2026-09-02), because a crossing built on invented rows would prove the contracts fit and hide whether the fixture does. The frame keys below (`crossing`, `node`, `input`, `output`, `expected_edges`) belong to this file alone; the keys inside the payloads belong to the manifests.
